title: Challenges in Designing Racially Inclusive Language Technologies

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual evaluation and synthesis of the psychological impacts of conversational user interface (CUI) miscommunication errors on Black users (functioning as microaggressions), alongside an analysis of extractive data collection practices, surveillance risks, and the need for anti-racist design frameworks.

Evaluating the disparate impacts of high speech recognition error rates on users of marginalized dialects and vernaculars, and analyzing the colonial methodologies historically used to collect representative voice and language data.
